title: Find the Highest Altitude
summary: Determine the peak altitude during a road trip involving n+1 points with varying altitudes.
statement: Determine the peak altitude during a road trip involving n+1 points with varying altitudes. The trip begins at point 0 with an altitude of 0. An array gain of length n provides the net altitude change between consecutive points. Calculate and return the highest altitude reached.
constraints: A biker starts at altitude zero; gain[i] is the signed altitude change to the next point.
Return the highest altitude among the starting point and every reached point.
hints: Reached altitudes are prefix sums of gain, with an empty-prefix altitude of zero.
Accumulate gains while tracking the largest running total.
Initialize altitude=highest=0; for each change update altitude and highest.
Every route point corresponds to exactly one prefix, so the maximum observed prefix sum is the answer.
editorial: Every route point corresponds to exactly one prefix, so the maximum observed prefix sum is the answer.

tests.explanation: The altitudes are 0,-5,-4,1,1,-6, so the highest is one.
Every reached altitude is below zero, making the starting altitude zero the maximum.
